title: Prospective Evaluation of Lung Ultrasound For Preterm Infants
summary: We want toch check if we can detect preterm babies that need an artificial medication for their lungs or mechanical ventilation during resuscitation

interventions.name: Preterm Infants (birthweight < 1500g) get lung ultrasound during resuscitation

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Preterm infants
birthweight < 1500 grams
Exclusion criteria:
thoracic malformations
perinatal pneumothorax, severe pleural effusions
